editorial:
Imagine feeling so guilty about your husband's death that you try to talk to him using a spirit board. That is exactly what Sara does, and it goes south very quickly. You get to follow her as she deals with her grief in a lonely house, but the mood shifts from sad to scary the moment she opens the door to the other side. It feels like a classic ghost story where a simple mistake leads to a total nightmare, making you feel the tension as something evil starts moving in the shadows.

The acting is solid and makes you really feel for Sara, even when she makes bad choices. While some of the jump scares are a bit predictable, the pacing keeps you on your toes until the end. If you love supernatural thrills, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to ensure you have the best picture quality for a movie night.
endingExplained: You find out that the spirit Sara invited in was not her husband at all, but a demon using his voice to trick her. In the final scenes, the entity tries to take over her body completely. Sara fights back to close the portal, but the twist is that the demon is too strong. It ends with a dark realization that once you let something in, it is almost impossible to get it back out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories and Ouija board movies.
